text:
Predicates:
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Settlement(x) ::: x is a settlement.
Bulgarian(x) ::: x is Bulgarian.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
PartOf(x, y) ::: x is part of y.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is Antarctica.

Premises:
NamedAfter(barutinCove, barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.
Settlement(barutin) ∧ Bulgarian(barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.
LocatedIn(barutinCove, snowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
PartOf(snowIsland, southShetlandIslands) ::: The South Shetland Islands include Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island.
PartOf(southShetlandIslands, antarctica) ::: The South Shetland Islands are considered part of Antarctica.
∀x ∀y ∀z ((LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ PartOf(y, z)) → LocatedIn(x, z)) ::: If A is located in B and B is located in C, then A is located in C.

Conclusion:
∃x ∃y (Cove(x) ∧ NamedAfter(x, y) ∧ Settlement(y) ∧ Bulgarian(y) ∧ LocatedIn(x, antarctica)) ::: There is at least one cove in Antarctica named after a place in Bulgaria.
